Achievement unlockedCampaign Crossover

Your Mod Store heroes can join a campaign. Sign a custom hero, a pack precon or a deck with custom cards onto the roster, and the run keeps its own copy of the pack, so updating or removing it never breaks the campaign. The deck builder gets Hero and Basic toggles and a picker for several packs and waves at once. And six of your reports are fixed, from Repurpose on a phone to Sinking Ferry and Firefox without WebGL.

Your heroes, your campaign

Issue #978 · PR #979
★
Achievement unlockedCarnage Signs the Roster

Custom heroes can join a campaign. A Mod Store hero, a pack's precon or one of your decks with custom cards is offered on Sign the roster, checked for legality like any other hero. Asked for by @bluefireF5ran.

The run keeps its own copy

  • Signing copies every pack the seats draw on into the run, so the campaign never depends on what is installed.
  • Updating the pack changes nothing in a run already under way, and removing it leaves the run playing on from its own copy, with no reinstall.
  • Every campaign screen, from the Briefing and the Market to the Finale, reads the run's copy of the pack.
  • A deck edit or a reward that adds a card from another installed pack copies that pack in too.
  • A custom hero with no hero art shows its identity card on the roster and the campaign screens.

One thing to know: if you remove a pack, its pictures go with it. The run plays on, and the hero shows its plain card frame until you install the pack again.

Pick your pool

Issue #977 · PR #980
★
Achievement unlockedMockingbird Sorts the Stack

The deck builder shows only the cards you want to see. Hero and Basic toggles hide those cards from the pool, so you can browse one aspect alone. The pack and wave buttons open a picker where you choose as many as you like. Asked for by @benpap24.

Filter your way

  • Hero and Basic toggles sit under Show. Turn one off to hide those cards.
  • The pack and wave buttons open a list where you pick several. With none picked, the pool shows them all.
  • Your choices stay when you come back to the deck builder.
  • Every row works with touch, the keyboard and a controller.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #984, #991, #993 · PRs #983, #990, #992, #994
★
Achievement unlockedIron Man Repurposes the Lab

Every card can be reached on a phone. A cost that picks cards in play, like Repurpose's Tech upgrade or Mutant Peacekeepers' allies, now opens the decision popup, with full card faces that scroll, card hover, Peek at table and Back out. The board's own target picks scroll too when they don't fit. Reported by GarethMagis on Discord.

Why was another card revealed?

When your deck runs out, you're dealt a facedown encounter card, and the villain phase reveals it with the rest. The game now says so: in the log, with a DECK RAN OUT mark on the encounter strip and a row in the recap's step 3.

Issue #984 from @milanga · PR #990

Sinking Ferry lets go

On Sinking Ferry and the other Disasters, exhausting a hero or an ally to remove a civilian counter no longer asks for resources when you can't spend them.

Issue #993 from @andy-xxvii27 · PR #994

Playing without WebGL

A browser with WebGL turned off, such as Firefox with webgl.disabled, used to stop with "Cannot create WebGL context". The game now plays on the slower Canvas renderer instead, and says once how to turn WebGL back on.

Reported on Discord · PR #983

Also in v0.54.0

PRs #976, #985, #986, #987
★
Achievement unlockedSentinel Runs the Checks
  • The Android APK carries Google's developer verification registration, so installing it from GitHub keeps working once Android requires verified developers.
  • The tests play all 14 Mod Store packs, adding Don't Make Me Angry! (Hulk), The Punisher, Sentinel, Spider-Punisher and The Rose.
  • For pack makers: the Mod SDK's community pack tests run in a job of their own, one test per smoke game, so they no longer time out.
  • The README's download buttons point at v0.53.0.
  • This report, in English and Spanish.
